name: Sabha
description: Connect OpenClaw to a Sabha chat server

enabled.label: Enabled
enabled.help: Enable or disable the Sabha channel

baseUrl.label: Server URL
baseUrl.help: Your Sabha server URL (include workspace ID for multi-tenant)

botKey.label: Bot key
botKey.help: Bot key from registration via join code

connectionMode.label: Connection mode
connectionMode.help: WebSocket (recommended) or webhook for receiving events

websocketUrl.label: WebSocket URL
websocketUrl.help: Auto-detected from registration. Override only if needed.

webhookPort.label: Webhook port
webhookPort.help: Port for webhook listener (webhook mode only)

dmPolicy.label: DM policy
dmPolicy.help: Who can send direct messages to the bot

allowFrom.label: Allow list
allowFrom.help: User IDs allowed to DM (allowlist mode only)
